title: Mummified Hand
description: Whenever you play a Power, a random card in your [gold]Hand[/gold] is free to play that turn.
flavor: [red]Details for this relic will be revealed in the future...[/red]
notes: When a Power card is played, a random card from your hand is selected to be free to play that turn. The selection uses a tiered priority system: first, cards that currently cost energy or stars with modifiers applied; second, any cards that cost energy or stars; third, cards with a base energy/star cost; and finally, any card in hand as a fallback.
